Senior Backend Engineer

Acme Robotics is looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join our fleet-management platform team.

Requirements:
- 5+ years of experience building production Node.js or Go services
- Required: strong experience with PostgreSQL and schema design
- You have deep experience with distributed systems and message queues
- Required: experience mentoring junior engineers and leading design reviews
- Bonus points for experience with robotics or IoT telemetry pipelines
- Nice to have: exposure to Kubernetes

You will design APIs consumed by our fleet of autonomous robots, review PRs, and mentor two junior engineers.
